Your {c_important}Eldritch{/c} Effects apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[{SF_3}|1|]{/c} seconds. {if:SF_2} 

Your {c_important}Psyche{/c} and {c_important}Growth & Decay{/c} damage apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for half of this duration ({c_random}[{SF_3}/2|1|]{/c} seconds).{/if}

Your {c_important}Psyche{/c} and {c_important}Growth & Decay{/c} damage also apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, for half the normal duration.
